card.statement: Let $\gl\subset\h$ be a coisotropic subgroup and $\alpha$ be a 2-cocycle of $\gl$ satisfying the conditions of theorem <<ref:coa>>. Then the category ${_{A}}{\cC(\h,\Omega)^{loc}}$ of local modules over the commutative algebra $A=k[\gl,\alpha]$ is equivalent, as a braided monoidal category, to the category $\cG(\gl^\di/(\gl+\gl^\ort),q)$ of $\gl^\di/(\gl+\gl^\ort)$-graded vector spaces, with the associativity and the braiding defined by $q$.
card.label: Proposition 15

paper.title: Commutative algebras in Drinfeld categories of abelian Lie algebras.
paper.abstract: We describe (braided-)commutative algebras with non-degenerate multiplicative form in certain braided monoidal categories, corresponding to abelian metric Lie algebras (so-called Drinfeld categories). We also describe local modules over these algebras and classify commutative algebras with finite number of simple local modules.
